nodes.display_name: Job Interview for person with disability
nodes.long_description:
1. Click the Watch Interview Preparation Video button and watch the video.
2. Click the Interview button and answer the interviewer's questions.
3. Click the View Previous Interview button and check your interview data.
nodes.short_description: Interview experience content is designed to help people with developmental disabilities improve their interview skills by watching interview preparation videos and experiencing interviews in virtual reality to check their eye movement, voice volume, speed, and length of answers.
